fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and coverage focused on Miami Beach’s municipal election and candidates, along with society/nightlife notes and entertainment listings. Sports and racing coverage highlights the opening of Tropical Park and related betting/handicapping content (including “Jockey Jimmy” selections). The issue also contains advertisements and notices for Miami and Miami Beach businesses, restaurants, bars, and events.
